body:
Real root cause: orbit only engaged on left-click miss, unreachable when the camera is near/inside geometry. Added WASD+QE continuous fly (full 3D forward, Shift boost, blur safety valve) and unconditional middle-mouse-drag orbit, before any raycast check -- left-click object interactions untouched. Resolved a real WASD collision with the existing spawner-nudge feature by moving that to arrow keys. tsc/vite clean, deployed, verified new ArrowUp literal in dist/ and deployed binary. IDUNA 341e396.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK level editor camera: fly (WASD+QE) + middle-mouse orbit (S487)
